newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Safeguards stock debuts at 4.80 rgt.
newsitem.headline: Safeguards stock debuts at 4.80 rgt.

text.p: Malaysia's Safeguards Corp Bhd stock made its market debut at 4.80 ringgit against an offer price of 1.70.
At seven minutes into the session, the stock was at 4.92 ringgit on volume of 783,000 traded. It has traded between 4.70 and 5.05 ringgit.
The security services company offered 5.25 million new and 4.375 million vendor shares for its listing on the Second Board of the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
Safeguards reported net earnings of 5.142 million ringgit and earnings per share (EPS) of 82 cents, on turnover of 54.36 million for the year neded June 30, 1996.
It forecast net earnings of 6.36 million ringgit and EPS of 36.5 cents for the current year, on the enlarged share capital.
